entities.name: Mitya's document
aliases: document in her hands, in Mitya's own writing

triples.subject: Alexey Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: saw a man coming down, and as they met, he recognized him as his brother.

triples.subject: Ivan Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: saw a man coming down, and as they met, he recognized him as his brother.

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: It was you, you who persuaded me that he murdered his father.

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: It’s not he murdered father, not he!

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: “Katerina Ivanovna loves you, brother,” said Alyosha sadly.

triples.subject: Alexey Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: he took Lise’s note from his pocket and held it out to Ivan.

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: She’s got a document in her hands, in Mitya’s own writing, that proves conclusively that he did murder Fyodor Pavlovitch.

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: It was you, you who persuaded me that he murdered his father. It’s only you I believed!

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: She’s got a document in her hands, in Mitya’s own writing, that proves conclusively that he did murder Fyodor Pavlovitch.

triples.subject: Ivan Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: You have accused yourself and have confessed to yourself that you are the murderer and no one else.

triples.subject: Ivan Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: Ivan lived some distance from him. He had taken a roomy and fairly comfortable lodge attached to a fine house

triples.subject: Marya Kondratyevna
triples.quote: where Marya Kondratyevna, the neighbor who used to come to Fyodor Pavlovitch’s kitchen for soup and to whom Smerdyakov had once sung his songs and played on the guitar, was now lodging.

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: Smerdyakov, who was ill—almost dying—had been with them ever since Fyodor Pavlovitch’s death.
